snippet.title: StarNomads Trailer
snippet.description: ​"StarNomads" is an upcoming real-time strategy (RTS) roguelike game with turn-based battles, developed by Barshem Interactive. In this game, players select a spaceship and embark on a mission to colonize various planets, each presenting unique and hostile environments. The gameplay involves gathering resources, constructing weapons, and upgrading equipment to enhance your ship's capabilities. Players must protect their mothership while engaging in strategic combat to eliminate enemies. The game offers multiple modes, including solo play, cooperative play with up to four players, and an arena mode supporting up to eight players for competitive battles. With diverse planetary environments and limitless upgrade possibilities, "StarNomads" challenges players to adapt their strategies to overcome ever-changing obstacles.
